top.badge: OPTIONAL META AI · REAL LOCAL AUDIO
intro.eyebrow: Build for Your World / Theatre and live events
intro.title: From script to approved cue
intro.description: Import a script, approve cues and play local audio with manual GO. Suggestions can be simulated or generated with Meta AI only after you configure the API and explicitly authorize sending an excerpt.
script.heading: Script
script.audioHint: Up to 20 MB · 10 min · mono/stereo. Reload audio after opening JSON.
proposals.heading: Proposals
proposals.help: Create manual test proposals or choose a Meta model provider if an API key is configured. No playback starts without human approval.
proposals.label: Cue description
proposals.metaNextButton: Analyze next scenes with Meta AI
proposals.metaDisclaimer: Each confirmation authorizes exactly one bounded Meta request containing up to two scene windows, read-only context and 80 audio filenames. No WAV/MP3 files are sent. API usage may incur charges; requests are not retried automatically.
proposals.coverageNone: Scene coverage: no Meta analysis completed yet.
proposals.coverageProgress: Scene coverage: {lines}/{totalLines} lines · {windows}/{totalWindows} windows across {scenes} scenes · {observations} non-PLAY observations · {duplicates} duplicates removed.
proposals.coverageComplete: Scene coverage complete: {lines}/{totalLines} lines · {windows}/{totalWindows} windows across {scenes} scenes · {observations} non-PLAY observations · {duplicates} duplicates removed.
scriptLanguage.label: Script language for AI
scriptLanguage.help: Independent of interface language. Keeps the original script unchanged.
cues.heading: Cue list
cues.help: Only expressly approved suggestions appear here. GO plays the loaded audio; STOP and FADE 1.5 s stop playback. The operator remains in control.
cues.scopeBody: TXT import, human review, local GO/STOP/FADE/STOP ALL and JSON export/import. Reload your audio files after closing or refreshing the page: audio is not embedded in JSON.
footer: Hackathon prototype · Local audio · Meta AI uses an external service only with consent · Save JSON to keep your changes

status.confirmMeta:
Authorize exactly one external, potentially billable Meta AI request?

This request covers scene window(s) {startWindow}–{endWindow} of {totalWindows}: {windowCount} window(s), {lineCount} target script line(s), bounded read-only context, and up to 80 audio filenames/IDs. No WAV/MP3 audio is sent. The request will not be retried automatically.

No cue will run automatically.

errors.invalidUtf8: The file must be valid UTF-8.

errors.metaAuth: Meta rejected your API key or account permissions. Check your API keys, credits and billing.

errors.metaBadRequest: Meta rejected the request (400). The model or schema may need adjustment.
errors.metaBusy: A model analysis is already running.
errors.metaService: Meta analysis could not be completed.
errors.metaSchemaIncompatible: Meta rejected the strict structured-output schema. No suggestions were imported.

errors.metaTransport: The local server could not reach Meta. The request was not retried.
errors.metaUpstreamEnvelope: Meta returned an incompatible response envelope. Nothing was imported.
errors.metaBilling: Meta reported a billing or credit requirement. Check the account before trying again.
errors.metaModelNotFound: Meta did not recognize the configured model or endpoint.
errors.metaUpstreamTimeout: Meta reported an upstream timeout. The request was not retried automatically.
errors.metaUpstreamHttp: Meta returned an upstream HTTP failure. No suggestions were imported.

proposals.basetenDisclaimer: Only after confirmation, the first 120 script lines (250 characters each) and up to 80 audio filenames/IDs are sent to Baseten to run a Meta open-weight model. No WAV/MP3 files are sent. Requests may use paid credits. Baseten Muse Spark Open does not guarantee structured JSON; invalid answers are rejected.

status.confirmBaseten:
Authorize an external Baseten request?

To run Meta Muse Spark Open, up to 120 script lines (250 characters each) and 80 audio resource names/IDs will be sent to Baseten. No WAV/MP3 files will be sent. Your Baseten credits may be charged.

No cue will execute automatically.
errors.basetenAuth: Baseten rejected the API key or account permissions. Check the key and credits.
errors.basetenRate: Baseten returned a request or credit limit. Check usage and limits before retrying.
errors.basetenModel: Baseten rejected the requested model or arguments. Check availability of the hackathon model.
errors.basetenBusy: An AI analysis is already running through Baseten.
errors.basetenService: Baseten inference failed. No proposals were imported.
errors.basetenOutputTruncated: Muse Spark stopped before finishing its response. No cue was imported.
errors.basetenOutputNotJson: Muse Spark returned text instead of a valid JSON proposal. No cue was imported.
errors.basetenOutputSchema: Muse Spark returned proposals in an unsupported format. No cue was imported.
errors.basetenOutputEmpty: Muse Spark returned empty or overly long content. No cue was imported.
errors.basetenBadReferences: Muse Spark referenced a script line or audio that is not in this project. Suggestions were rejected for safety.

errors.metaOutputTruncated: Meta stopped before completing the structured cue response. Nothing was imported.
errors.metaOutputNotJson: Meta returned content that could not be parsed as JSON. No cues were imported.
errors.metaOutputSchema: Meta returned an unexpected cue schema. No cues were imported.
errors.metaOutputEmpty: Meta returned empty or oversized content. No cues were imported.
errors.metaOutputRefused: Meta refused or filtered the requested output. No cues were imported.
